release_rule: A template revision is NOT released until, in the SAME session: (1) this template.html + manifest are re-frozen in the repo, (2) the skill bundle is re-saved with the matching pp_template.html and SKILL.md, (3) the nightly task prompt carries no stale revision facts. notes: R44 (2026-08-06, per Stephen): FULL-SCREEN JOB CARD + PROJECT ROLLUP - 'on the jobs tab, when you expand a job, the labor breakdown is condensed so you cant see the numbers... that table only expands partially, it should fill the screen... since it has the job# and project# it can connect jobs to projects... we need to know what the total revenue, discount, labor %, purchase%, Gross margin %, Gross Profit $ is for all the jobs on the project combined.' Three fixes, all display-only. (1) The old inline <tr class=det> expansion rendered INSIDE table.jobs, so nested cells inherited white-space:nowrap and the long labor-build labels overlapped/clipped the numbers (the Techs line clipped mid-name at 1600px). (2) It sat inside the gridwrap 70vh scroll box, so it only ever opened partially. Clicking a job now opens a fixed full-screen overlay card (.jdov, body-level, outside the table): waterfall / labor build (assumed-vs-actual COM and install plan-vs-posted inline on wrapped readable lines + a Direct Labor total row) / commission derivation, close via X, Esc or backdrop click. (3) When the job carries a Project #, the card adds the Project rollup: every sibling job on that project in the loaded month (revenue-desc rows: rev, counting disc, labor $ %, purchases $ %, GM % $, current job highlighted, member rows click through to their own card) plus six combined tiles - Total revenue, Discounts (+ project disc % of book -> comm rate off the engine's own project tier), Labor %, Purchases %, GM % (gm-banded pill), GP $ - because one compliant project sale is often split across several jobs/crews (dig/drywall/pipe/backfill) and one job can margin poorly while the PROJECT as sold is healthy. Aggregation is pure display arithmetic over the engine's per-job records (same convention as the grid TOTAL row); the engine's project grouping/tier math (computeAll 'projects' map) is UNTOUCHED. Notes state the month-window caveat, the subs/permits-in-GM reconciliation and benign-credit exclusion. buildSaveHtml splices PAGE0 so an open card never serializes into a saved copy. Verified 2026-08-06 (jsdom, June exports, frozen build.js, goals=skip): gates 6/6 both engines, 3,902 jobs / $6,087,636 / GM 55.3% exact, RAW byte-identical (builtAt normalized), 12/12 rendered panes (Summary+recon/P&L/Jobs/Trends x Branch/HVAC/Plumb) byte-identical, every summary key identical; 39/39 A/B+smoke checks green incl. combined stats reconciling to independent sums to the cent on a live 5-job project (P627979490: $25,333 rev / $1,333 disc / 24.8% labor / 11.3% purch / 63.5% GM / $16,095 GP), member click-through, Esc/X/backdrop close, solo-project note, no-project card without the section, save round-trip carrying R44 code with no live overlay markup; Chromium screenshots confirm the old clipping and the new card. June data carries 540 multi-job projects. Whole-file diff vs R43 = 10 intended hunks (overlay+pjsec CSS, mobile CSS, header/footer stamps, footer changelog, toggleDetail->showDetail/pjRollup, Instructions section 9). build.js and close.js run VERBATIM.  || R45 (2026-08-07): Review Desk repaint fix + reflag-on-sync + per-system HVAC install assumption + rebuilt Pay Plan tab. Reproduced the desk failure end-to-end in jsdom against a wired CFG with a mocked private-repo state.json: sync pulled 5 approvals / 3 watch / 8 log entries, and the R44 desk still reported 'No review activity recorded yet' with 0 approved / 0 watchlist while the Jobs tab's own pills read 'Approved (0) | Watchlist (0)' until clicked, at which point they immediately corrected to 'Approved (5) | Watchlist (3)' — the exact asymmetry reported. On R45 the desk populates before any click (HVAC 3 approved / 1 watch, Plumbing 2 / 1, reviewer table AG/RP/TR/EO, open queue 171 -> 164) and repaints again on tab open. A/B vs R44 on mature June: jobs 3,902 / $6,087,636 / GM 55.3%, flag set identical (171), per-job rev+purch+labor+GM+instTop identical, all 71 pre-existing summary keys x 3 scopes identical, 9/12 rendered panes byte-identical (the 3 Summary panes differ only by the Reconciliation label). r45.review_desk_fix: THE bug: `const PPUI = (()=>{...})()` binds in the global LEXICAL environment, which is NOT a property of window, so STX.pull()'s completion guard `if(window.PPUI&&PPUI.stateChanged)` evaluated undefined on EVERY load since R17 and the post-sync repaint never fired. Under a wired CFG, STATE0 ships empty (SKILL 3c), so the desk painted once against empty state and stayed there. The Jobs tab masked it — its view pills, filter chips and column sorts all call renderJobs(), so Approved/Watchlist self-healed on first click, which is exactly the symptom Stephen reported. Fix: `window.PPUI=PPUI;` after the IIFE, plus setTab() now calls renderDesk() when the desk tab is opened (independent second path).
r45.reflag_fix: checkReflags() ran only under recompute(fromIngest) — i.e. only on a manual file drop. On the nightly site every viewer loads RAW and never drops a file, so approved-then-went-bad was never detected and the desk's 'Approved then went bad' row could not light up. stateChanged() now runs it once when synced state lands, guarded to nightly data (!S.manual, pay+disc present). Idempotent: it consumes the approval it reflags. Verified: honest snapshots survive with ZERO reflags and ZERO state PUTs; stale snapshots reflag correctly.
r45.install_per_system: HVAC assumed install pay is now book rate x systems sold. Count comes from parseDisc: priced lines with Item GL Group Name 'HVAC- Replacement', summed by Item Quantity into families sp/pk/ms (mini tested FIRST — 'Mini-Split' contains 'split'); blank/zero quantity on a priced line reads as 1. INSTDEF.fam limits it to the six EQUIPMENT-system job types (4 Splits, Package, Mini-Split); INSTDEF.qtyCap=6. Duct-System, Partial, Insulation and Clean/Seal/IAQ are DELIBERATELY excluded — their invoice quantity is inches / square footage / scope, not a unit count (measured: an Insulation job reads quantity 6 against $228 of real pay, which would over-assume by $1,128). Plumbing needs no multiplier — 8% of revenue already scales with the sale.
r45.install_verification: June 2026: 127 priced system lines parsed; 11 of 326 HVAC book-rate install jobs are multi-system (nine 2-system, two 3-system, 3.4%). Exact book-vs-posted agreement rises 151 -> 160 of 315 paid jobs with ZERO new over-assumptions (the only 2 over-assumed jobs were already over-assumed at x1). Synthetic young clock (as-of 2026-07-01) with install pay zeroed on the 7 in-window multi-system jobs: R44 assumes $9,100, R45 assumes $20,900 — $11,800 previously invisible; worst single job 544995 (3 systems, $30K) read GM 58.1% under R44 vs the honest 49.1%. Flag set unchanged (171 both), pending-materials accrual identical to the cent (the R42 netting invariant holds).
r45.pay_plan_tab: Variables -> Pay Plan rebuilt as documentation a newcomer can follow: 4 quick-reference cards, pay-code decoder, commission ladder + discount-cliff bar chart, HVAC flat-rate book table with a 'x systems?' column beside Plumbing's flat 8% + effective-%-of-revenue bar chart, 4 worked examples, assumed-install timeline (day 0-14 floor -> day 15 actuals), payroll calendar + stub-length table, pay-code landing-curve chart, and a sourced June-2026 verification block. Static HTML + a scoped .pp* CSS block; no script, no bindings, no engine contact.
r45.summary_keys_added: instMultiN (jobs with a top-up AND >1 system), instMultiSys (total systems on those jobs) — both 0 on a mature month.
r45.untouched: parsers otherwise, project/tier math, buckets, GM/CP, accrual vector + R42 netting, Handoff, Trends, flag definitions, renderJobs, the job card and project rollup. build.js, close.js, snap.js and ages.py run VERBATIM (snap.js on R45 reproduces 171 flagged / 126 HVAC / 45 Plumb / $299,421, identical to R44).
r45.raw_compat: Pre-R45 RAW (saved copies, reused nightly data) carries no `units` — computeAll falls back to x1, i.e. exactly R42/R44 behavior. Files saved FROM R45 carry the counts and keep the multiplier.

r46.source: The OPTIONAL 'Job ID' column of the Job Costing w/ Project info export (added by Stephen 2026-08-07). This is the ServiceTitan INTERNAL job id (9-digit, e.g. 644584905) and is a DIFFERENT number from the 6-digit Job # (e.g. 552304). Only the internal id can address a job in the ServiceTitan UI.

r46.parser: stIdOf() accepts digits only, 6-12 long, after stripping whitespace and commas; anything else -> null. parseJobs attaches rec.stid ONLY when non-null. Column resolution is by header NAME (the engine's existing findHeader/H map), never positional.
r46.render: stLink(j) returns Job# when j.stid is set, else the bare job number. stopPropagation is MANDATORY: two of the four call sites sit inside a clickable row (Jobs grid opens the job card, project-rollup member row navigates) and without it a click would follow the link AND fire the row handler. CSS: .stl med-blue, dotted underline, small superscript arrow affordance.
r46.degrade: A missing 'Job ID' column, a blank cell, or a non-numeric value is a SOFT degrade — the job number renders as plain text exactly as R45. Never a stop, never a flag, never a gate failure.

r47.what: Approve / Watchlist actions inside the R44 full-screen job card. Per Stephen 2026-08-07: 'on the jobs tab, when I expand a job, add the watchlist and approve button to the top right of the expanded box, so a job can be added to the watchlist, or be approved from there. and if a job is added to either approved, or the watchlist from that screen, then close the expanded box.'
r47.render: cardReview(j) builds the button group; showDetail() wraps it plus the existing close button in <div class="rvg"> at the right of the .hd header (margin-left:auto). State-driven: active -> [Approve if j.flags.length||ST.reflag[job]] + [Watchlist]; watch -> 'Watching BY M/D' + [Approve] + [Remove from watchlist]; approved -> 'Approved BY M/D' + [Undo approval]. Same .ab / .ab.ok / .ab.rm classes as the grid, sized up (12px) for the card.
r47.approve_scope: Approve is offered ONLY where the Jobs-grid review column offers it (a flagged or re-flagged job) - approving an unflagged job would record an approval that clears nothing. Watchlist is offered on ANY job (per Stephen): parking a clean job you want to keep an eye on is the point of a watchlist. This is the one intentional divergence from reviewCell().
r47.close_rule: doAction() now RETURNS true only when STX.record() actually persisted a state change (approve / watch / unapprove / unwatch); it returns false on a cancelled initials or note prompt, on the disabled manual-data path, and on every note action. The card handler is `if(doAction(a,job)) closeDetail();` - so a recorded action closes the card and a cancel leaves it open. The Jobs-grid handler ignores the return value and is byte-identical in behaviour.
r47.one_workflow: Same STX actions, same ST state model, same initials() stamp, same confirm() prompts and the same STX.wired()&&S.manual disabled rule as the grid. renderJobs() still runs inside doAction, so the view pills (Approved (n) / Watchlist (n)), the grid rows and the Review Desk all move together. No second state store, no second code path.

RAW (1,223,163 chars, modulo builtAt); 21/21 rendered panes (7 tabs x 3 scopes) byte-identical modulo the R46->R47 stamp and the build clock. Functional 28/28: flagged card exposes Approve+Watchlist; Watch records and closes; reopened watched job shows 'Watching SG' + Approve + Remove and no duplicate Watch; Approve records, closes, moves Watchlist 1->0 and Approved 0->1; reopened approved job shows 'Approved SG' + Undo only; Undo records and closes; a cancelled prompt records nothing and leaves the card open; a clean job offers Watchlist but not Approve; Esc still closes; buildSaveHtml body carries no live overlay and stamps R47; zero engine alerts. Chromium screenshots confirm the three header states and a clean wrap at 430px.

r48.what: Duct-System and Partial join the assumed-install-pay multiplier. Per Stephen 2026-08-12: 'if something pays flat rate, and they do 5 they get 5 times... thats all job types, and nobody in the world would ever think otherwise.'
r48.why_r45_was_wrong: R45 excluded Duct-System, Partial, Insulation and Clean/Seal/IAQ on the stated grounds that their invoice quantity is inches/square footage/scope rather than a unit count. Measured against Q2-2026 (Apr-Jun, 217 paid Duct/Partial jobs) that is FALSE for Duct-System and Partial: every priced 'HVAC- Replacement' line on those tickets is one discrete piece of equipment at quantity 1 ('3 Star Duct (4-5 Ton)' n=36 qmin=qmax=1; '1-Star, 4-Ton AC Condenser' n=22; '5 Ton Cased Coil' n=6), so the LINE COUNT is the piece count. Payroll pays the multiple: 2-duct jobs paid exactly $2,600 (2 x $1,300), a 3-piece Partial exactly $1,800 (3 x $600).
r48.counting: New family 'eq' in dim units = every priced HVAC- Replacement line on the ticket (NOT bucketed to one equipment family, because a Partial mixes condensers, coils, air handlers and duct on one job). Per-line quantity above INSTDEF.qtyCap reads as 1 (an area/length measure, never a piece count); NONUNIT_RE excludes labor-warranty lines. INSTDEF.fam maps Duct-System and Partial to 'eq'.
r48.steps: INSTDEF.steps overrides book x count where payroll uses a BANDED piece-count rate. Partial measured Q2: 1 piece $600 (53 of 81 jobs exact), 2 pieces $1,000 (21 of 31 exact - NOT $1,200), 3 pieces $1,800. steps={'H-Install Partial':{2:1000}}; counts outside the table fall through to book x count.
r48.still_excluded: Insulation and Clean/Seal/IAQ. There the R45 reasoning HOLDS: blown-in insulation bills square footage (850-2,600 per line), and neither carries a real flat rate - 29 distinct pay amounts across 69 Insulation jobs, 78 across 199 Clean/Seal jobs. Their $226/$161 is a measured MEDIAN, not a book rate, so there is nothing to multiply. Fixing those requires the actual HVAC install flat-rate sheet.
r48.raw: parseDisc now writes units.eq on any job with a priced HVAC- Replacement line. On June this ADDS 36 byJob entries that carry nothing but units.eq (every other field at its default, i.e. numerically inert - discBy already defaults to exactly that zero object) and leaves all 821 pre-existing entries byte-identical once eq is dropped. Pre-R48 saved copies have no eq key -> falls back to x1 = exactly R47 behavior.

Flags 171 unchanged; snap.js reproduces the ledger exactly (171 flagged / 126 HVAC / 45 Plumb / $299,421.09). r50.title: Approve is now Reviewed; undo is now Re-Flag

r51.summary: HVAC purchase flags go spec-first via the Task-to-Purchase map (v3, 381 builds / 538 task codes, locked by Stephen 2026-08-18). Jobs whose invoice carries a mapped 'HVAC- Replacement' task are judged on the exact expected package instead of the % band: condenser/package tonnage must match the task EXACTLY; coil/furnace/air-handler may upsize vs the condenser, never downsize; each piece checks against its category's priciest acceptable option; the package checks against band-high (with-coil band applied when a coil was bought); Material-typed PO total checks against the map's mat band with calibration dials in the map file (cal.matMult default 2.5, cal.matFloor default $1000 — the raw p75 band flagged 88% of June's mapped jobs, the calibrated line flags the true tail at ~14%). All checks remain the ONE PURCH-CAP flag with reason bubbles +EQ / TON / $HI / MAT; legacy band jobs show a % or $ bubble. Two new markers: TPM (the map, from Claude Docs/Profit Planner/task_to_purchase_map_data.json, private-repo fallback tpm/) and EQPO (job-tagged equipment+rescue PO lines and per-job Material-typed PO sums from Databricks fact_purchase_order_item, window minus 30 days to window end plus 7). Null payloads = byte-identical flagging to R50 (mapped-task jobs fall back to the band; the bands tab and job card say so). Surfaces: cap-type bubbles on PURCH-CAP pills, muted job-cell markers (map = judged by map, map~ = mapped task but no PO lines so band fallback), 'Flags & purchase plan' block on the job card (plain-language reason per flag + expected-package vs bought-pieces tables with per-piece verdicts, returns caveat on +EQ), and the flag-bands tab map panel (coverage summary, per-type coverage, collapsible per-job table).

Functional smoke 21/21: bubbles render (map reasons + legacy %/$), map markers, card open/detail/close, bands panel (summary, type coverage, 168-row job table), save round-trip carries TPM+EQPO and recomputes identically with zero errors. build.js, close.js, snap.js, ages.py all run VERBATIM.
